التظيت (form VIII)
# اِلْتَظَيْتُ (iltaẓaytu) /il.ta.ðˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
# اِلْتَظَيْتَ (iltaẓayta) /il.ta.ðˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
# اِلْتَظَيْتِ (iltaẓayti) /il.ta.ðˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
